admission.justification: Realized across PaseoChatFrame.tsx, paseoFrameControl.ts, and paseoFrameModel.ts and guarded by component and real-bridge tests; prevents silent blank workspaces when Paseo strips ?open=agent:<id> or ?arPage=document on empty storage.

applicability: Embedded chat frame wait-state calculation whenever control is unavailable and the wanted agent has not been confirmed as shown.
conditions: PaseoFrameControl.publish sets urlOnly true only when the plug-in explicitly announced capabilities lacking open-agent.
When control is unavailable and showing.urlOnly is false, frameWait returns unavailableWaitText with Retry instead of IN_REACH even when showing.landed equals agentId.
Late ready on a document page restores document-page behaviour through ar.page even when Paseo stripped ?arPage=document.
exclusions: A plug-in that explicitly reports lacking open-agent keeps URL-landed IN_REACH semantics.
Confirmed shown targets return IN_REACH immediately.

evidence: npx --prefix dashboard vitest run src/cockpit/paseoFrameLateAnswer.test.tsx src/cockpit/PaseoChatFrame.test.tsx; report 261112-BUG-L62-worker-9e7b04bc-afc8-55ae-afa7-c9e1e9ca0088.md

statement: When control is unavailable without an explicit plug-in report lacking open-agent capability, an unconfirmed URL-landed agent is not treated as in-reach and instead displays a bounded waiting notice with Retry while late ready still opens the chat and restores document-page mode via ar.page.
title: Unconfirmed URL-landed chat waits with Retry while control is unavailable
